title: Flik and the ants.
lines: A colony of ants lives on a small island.
But the food isn't for them.
They eat up all the food.
One of the ants is called Flik.
Flik is different from the other ants.
He makes machines to pick grain faster.
But his inventions often go wrong.
One day his machine falls over.
All the grain for the grasshoppers falls into the water!
I'll come back when the last leaves fall, he says.
And then I want twice as much food!
I'll go and find strong warriors.
They'll help us against the grasshoppers.
Flik travels to the big city of the insects.
There he sees a group of insects.
The performers don't dare to say they aren't warriors.
Then a little ant princess is almost eaten by a bird.
They build a big bird out of leaves and twigs.
The grasshoppers get a fright and flee.
The grasshoppers see that it's fake.
But Flik stands up to him.
There are many more of us!
They fly away and never come back.
The performers go on with their circus.
